name: Kalen Sori
occupation: Stoneworker / Structural Maintainer / Monument Repair Overseer
daily_routine: studying wear patterns in ancient buildings
monitoring structural shifts after seasonal rains
cataloging reused or replaced stone sections

goals.public_goal: Maintain structural integrity of all major stoneworks, prevent collapse or degradation of monument systems, and ensure safe use of plaza and temple infrastructure
goals.hidden_goal: Identify original construction phases of the monument complex and separate original stonework from later repairs
goals.deep_goal: Understand whether different sections of the monument were built at different times or by different methods

beliefs: Stonework preserves truth better than stories
Most mysteries are just misunderstood construction layers
Reused stone tells a history people forget to read
Structural anomalies are more important than legends
The monument is not a single object, but a layered system
